They are shallow, don't care about our health.
Again, about 5 years ago I had another problem with my back, I couldn't even walk and this was a recurring problem. They kept telling me that there was nothing to do, just to get paracetamol and get some rest, until I got to the point that I couldn't walk for real, then only after 3 years FINALLY they prescribed an MRI and guess what (again)? "what do you eat?" etc... and then he just said "well, you have nothing, it's just the warm weather. Avoid fatty food and drink more water". 5 years later, where I kept feeling in the same way, finally, and only after the 10th visit where I was having constant banging headaches, another doctor FINALLY visited me, checked my blood pressure and (again) guess what? I have hypertension and needed medications. I risked a stroke or heart attack for 5 years!!!

I've had enough of them now, I feel I'm a survivor, a lucky one but I can see that one day I won't be so lucky if I stay with them, so I decided to go somewhere else for a chance to live longer.

As a foot note: the Nurses are absolutely fine. They are lovely and care about patients.

wife has been a patient of this practice all her life, she is now in her fifty’s. Up until the practice moved to Lime Square, and sadly Doctors Saeed and Jamil left, she never had a problem with the practice, their procedures, or their staff. The doctors were always polite and helpful, even though their time was limited. You only have to look at the reviews on this page, to see that there has been a serious decline in the number of positive reviews for this practice, there is something seriously wrong when they fail to get the basics right!!! It was confirmed to me that if you raise your concerns too many times a practice can drop you from their patient list. If you have a concern, especially when it concerns your health, it should be addressed in a professional manner, you should not be made to feel that you are on borrowed time and that it would be in your interest to say nothing.

In the last two years my wife has seen two doctors at this practice, i will refer to them as Dr U & Dr S. Two doctors who in my wife’s opinion could not be more different when it comes to their attitude.  Unfortunately, she was recently informed that Dr U had left the practice. However, Doctor S. who I’m sure is a good Doctor, has been abrupt, rude, impatient, and confrontational with my wife, mainly because she expressed her concerns stemming from inconsistences within the practice. These inconsistences have the potential of causing serious issues when it comes to patient health and their medication. No Doctor knows everything that goes on within any practice, it is both arrogant and selfish to think otherwise.

Issues

•	Request from pharmacy was not processed for five days.
•	Prescription not passed to driver (pharmacy) by reception staff for
five days.
•	Prescription requested for three items. Prescription produced for
only one, three-day delay (including weekend) before the other
prescription was ready to be filled by the pharmacy.
•	Emergency home visit requested and refused, “we are too busy,
there’s nothing we can do”! no further help was offered or suggested.

This practice needs to employ staff that know what they are doing, it's no joke, some training is urgently needed! At the very least the reception staff should understand the procedure when it comes to a patients prescription.  Before Christmas my sister over heard one of the reception staff say that they try not to book too many people in on a Friday so they have a quieter day!  I don't know whether that is happening or not, but to even suggest such a thing is total unprofessional, who is in charge at this
